title.zh: 规定任命三人委员会赴日本、台湾、上缅甸及爪哇，以及文官总督指定的其他国家，调查鸦片使用与交易情况，以及规制此类使用与交易的规则、条例与法律，并向菲律宾委员会提交结论报告的法案
title.en: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE APPOINTMENT OF A COMMITTEE OF THREE TO VISIT JAPAN, FORMOSA, UPPER BURMAH, AND JAVA, AND SUCH OTHER COUNTRIES AS THE CIVIL GOVERNOR MAY DESIGNATE, FOR THE PURPOSE OF INVESTIGATING THE USE OF OPIUM AND THE TRAFFIC THEREIN, AND RULES, ORDINANCES, AND LAWS REGULATING SUCH USE AND TRAFFIC, AND TO MAKE A REPORT OF THEIR CONCLUSIONS TO THE PHILIPPINE COMMISSION.

title.vi: Đạo luật quy định bổ nhiệm ủy ban ba người đi thăm Nhật Bản, Đài Loan, Miến Điện Thượng và Java, cũng như các quốc gia khác do Thống đốc Dân sự chỉ định, nhằm điều tra việc sử dụng và buôn bán thuốc phiện, cũng như các quy tắc, điều lệ và luật điều chỉnh việc sử dụng và buôn bán đó, và báo cáo kết luận lên Ủy ban Philippines
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติกำหนดให้มีการแต่งตั้งคณะกรรมการสามคนไปเยือนญี่ปุ่นไต้หวันพม่าตอนบนและชวาและประเทศอื่นใดที่ผู้ว่าการพลเรือนกำหนดเพื่อตรวจสอบการใช้ฝิ่นและการค้าฝิ่นรวมทั้งกฎระเบียบข้อบังคับและกฎหมายที่ควบคุมการใช้และการค้าดังกล่าวและจัดทำรายงานข้อสรุปเสนอต่อคณะกรรมาธิการฟิลิปปินส์
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan penunjukan komite tiga orang untuk mengunjungi Jepang, Formosa, Burma Atas, dan Jawa, serta negara lain yang ditunjuk Gubernur Sipil, guna menyelidiki penggunaan dan perdagangan opium serta aturan, peraturan, dan undang-undang yang mengatur penggunaan dan perdagangan tersebut, serta menyampaikan laporan kesimpulan kepada Komisi Filipina
title.ms: Akta menetapkan perlantikan jawatankuasa tiga orang untuk melawat Jepun, Taiwan, Burma Atas dan Jawa serta negara-negara lain yang ditetapkan oleh Gabenor Awam bagi tujuan menyiasat penggunaan dan perdagangan dadah opium dan peraturan, ordinan dan undang-undang yang mengawal penggunaan dan perdagangan tersebut serta membuat laporan kesimpulan mereka kepada Suruhanjaya Filipina

text.en:
The Civil Governor is hereby authorized and directed to appoint, by and with the consent of the
Philippine Commission, a committee of three to visit Japan, Formosa, Upper Burmah, and Java, and such
other countries as the Civil Governor may designate, for the purpose of investigating the use of opium and
the traffic therein, and the rules, ordinances, and laws regulating such use and traffic.

Within four months after its appointment, or within such further time as may be granted by the
Civil Governor, such committee shall make a report of its investigations to the Philippine Commission,
setting forth therein the facts as found by it, its conclusions therefrom, and such recommendations as to it
may seem advisable under all the circumstances.

The Civil Governor shall designate a stenographer from a Bureau or Department of the
Government who shall accompany the committee and whose actual, reasonable, and necessary traveling
expenses shall be paid, to be used by the committee in taking evidence and in preparing its report. He shall
also act as disbursing officer of the committee after having given proper bond, the premium of the bond to be
paid out of the fund hereinafter appropriated.

Each member of such committee shall receive a compensation at the rate of two hundred and fifty
dollars, United States currency, per month, together with his actual, reasonable, and necessary traveling
expenses while engaged in the performance of the duties prescribed by this Act: Provided, That the
compensation prescribed by this section shall not be paid to any member of the committee who is an officer
or employee in the public service of the Insular Government, or whose salary or compensation is fixed by

law or regulation: Provided further, That if a provincial official is appointed he may renounce his provincial
salary while engaged in this service and receive the salary provided by this Act.

The sum of seven thousand dollars, United States currency, or its equivalent in Philippines
currency, is hereby appropriated, out of any moneys in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for
the purposes of this Act.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, July 23, 1903.
